skill.name: workflow-orchestration
skill.description: Coordinates CI/CD workflow pipelines by combining validation, code review, commit planning, PR delegation, and CI recovery steps.
skill.summary: Coordinates validation, review, commit planning, PR delegation, and CI recovery workflows.
skill.author: ANcpLua

security_audit.summary: Most static hits are Markdown inline code and fenced examples, not Ruby backtick execution. I confirmed the findings where the skill instructs agents to execute local validation or plugin scripts during CI/CD automation; no prompt-injection language or malicious intent was found.

remediation.issue: Local validation and CI scripts run from the workspace.
remediation.suggestion: Keep script paths hardcoded, display planned commands, and require confirmation before running scripts from untrusted repositories.

remediation.issue: PR delegation may involve an external Jules integration and API credentials.
remediation.suggestion: Document what project data is shared, keep requirePlanApproval enabled, and never print or store API keys in logs.

remediation.issue: Command examples mix read-only checks with mutating workflow steps.
remediation.suggestion: Separate read-only inspection, script execution, file edits, and commit approval steps so users can review each boundary.

content.value_statement: Multi-step CI and PR work can lose context across tools. This skill coordinates validation, review, commit planning, and recovery steps with clear checkpoints.
actual_capabilities: Selects pre-commit, PR-create, or CI-recover pipelines based on the task.
Checks project context from CHANGELOG, git status, recent commits, and CI state.
Coordinates validation, code review, commit-message generation, and PR delegation skills.
Runs local validation workflows and reports pass or fail evidence.
Requires human approval before commit and PR actions proceed.
Escalates repeated validation or CI recovery failures with context.
limitations: Requires the referenced plugins and skills to be installed and available.
Assumes the repository provides the documented validation and CI scripts.
Does not replace human review for commits, diffs, PRs, or external delegation.
Can only diagnose failures that are visible in local output or CI logs.

use_cases.title: Validate Changes Before Commit
use_cases.description: Run a structured pre-commit flow that checks validation, review findings, and commit-message readiness.

use_cases.title: Prepare Review-Ready Pull Requests
use_cases.description: Coordinate validation, diff review, human approval, and optional PR delegation in one tracked workflow.

use_cases.title: Recover Failed CI Runs
use_cases.description: Diagnose CI failures, apply deterministic fixes, rerun validation, and escalate when retries do not resolve the issue.

prompt_templates.title: Run Pre-Commit Checks
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request for safe local validation.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use workflow-orchestration to validate my current changes before commit. Read project context, run the pre-commit pipeline, and report evidence.

prompt_templates.title: Review and Suggest Commit Message
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate request after local changes are complete.
prompt_templates.prompt: Run the workflow-orchestration pre-commit pipeline. Include validation status, review findings, and a suggested conventional commit message for approval.

prompt_templates.title: Recover a CI Failure
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced troubleshooting request for a broken pipeline.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use workflow-orchestration to diagnose the failing CI run. Apply only deterministic fixes, rerun validation, and escalate if three attempts fail.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare a PR Workflow
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced release or feature handoff request.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use workflow-orchestration to prepare this change for a PR. Validate, review the diff, request commit approval, and use Jules only after approval.

output_examples.input: Validate my feature branch before I commit.
output: Local checks passed and review found no critical issues.
A commit message is ready for human approval.

output_examples.input: CI failed after my last change. Recover it.
output: The failure was isolated to a shell lint issue.
A deterministic fix was applied and validation passed after rerun.

output_examples.input: Prepare this completed work for a pull request.
output: Validation and review completed before staging.
The diff is ready for approval before external delegation.

best_practices: Confirm required plugins and scripts before starting a pipeline.
Review diffs and command plans before any commit or PR step.
Keep CHANGELOG context current when workflow steps change files.
anti_patterns: Running validation scripts from an untrusted repository without review.
Skipping validation after automated fixes or CI recovery attempts.
Delegating PR creation before confirming privacy and approval boundaries.

faq.question: What does this skill orchestrate?
faq.answer: It coordinates validation, code review, commit planning, PR preparation, and CI recovery workflows.

faq.question: Does it commit code automatically?
faq.answer: No. The documented flow requires human approval before commit and PR actions continue.

faq.question: Which tools does it depend on?
faq.answer: It references autonomous-ci, code-review, smart-commit, jules-integration, and several Superpowers skills.

faq.question: Can it fix CI failures?
faq.answer: It can guide diagnosis, deterministic fixes, validation reruns, and escalation after repeated failures.

faq.question: Is it useful without Jules integration?
faq.answer: Yes. Pre-commit validation and CI recovery can still run without optional PR delegation.

faq.question: What should users review first?
faq.answer: Review available plugins, script paths, repository trust, and any external delegation settings.
